data.scope: Authenticated private Gateway request through real Worker key generation, durable two-role installation, initial signing stock, and client custody verification. Public login and SDK UI are outside this campaign.

Whole-invocation CPU and wall time include fixture key creation, preparation, online work, and cleanup. Request headers, complete URLs, credentials, exception messages, and unselected logs are excluded. Cloudflare can redact run_id query values; unavailable identifiers remain null. The original instances_started label counts binding-phase notifications, including chunk bindings. New traces label this binding_phases_started. Wasm linear memory is not total isolate memory. Signing outcomes describe role dispatch before Router verification and settlement.

traces.selection: Retain every registration/signing counter, non-ok invocation, and register/sign/execute route.
